_comment: Per-attribute value overrides for the conformance sweep.
The generator picks values from the device's own completion lists, which
are correct per attribute but occasionally illegal in isolation because
RouterOS enforces a cross-property constraint. /ip/ipsec/proposal rejects
an AEAD cipher alongside any auth algorithm ('AEAD already provides
authentication') and one is set by default, so chacha20poly1305 can never
Record a compatible pair here rather than weakening the sweep. Keyed by
